digest.overview: 今日两条 OLED 相关动态均围绕发光材料与效率提升：一条报道单分子白光 OLED 创下 27.1% 外量子效率纪录，另一条是 TADF/Hyperfluorescence 材料商 Kyulux 获 LG Display 与三星战略投资并签署联合开发协议。整体看，材料端的单发光体简化方案与 TADF 商业化融资是今日焦点。

news.title_zh: 研究人员开发出使用单一 MR-TADF 发光分子的创纪录效率白光 OLED
news.summary_zh: 吉林大学与季华实验室的研究人员开发出一种使用单一发光分子（单一掺杂剂）的暖白光 OLED，发光材料 Th-DBN 为多共振 TADF（MR-TADF）材料，单独存在时发蓝绿光、两分子堆叠时发橙黄光。该器件外量子效率（EQE）达到 27.1%，研究团队称这是纯有机单掺杂白光 OLED 迄今报道的最高值，接近此前纪录的两倍。
news.why: 单发光体白光方案可减少发光层沉积步骤、降低成本并缓解随亮度变化的色偏问题，若效率纪录可复现，将对白光 OLED 的材料与制程路线产生影响。

news.title_zh: Kyulux 完成 5370 万美元 D 轮融资，获 LG Display 与三星投资，并与 LGD 签署联合开发协议
news.summary_zh: 日本 TADF 与 Hyperfluorescence OLED 发光材料开发商 Kyulux 完成 85 亿日元（约 5370 万美元）D 轮融资，公司估值约 2.72 亿美元，投资方包括 SMBC Capital Partners、韩国私募 H&Q 与 BNW。两家韩国面板厂作为战略投资者参与：LG Display 直接投资，三星通过 Samsung Venture Investment Corporation 投资；同时 Kyulux 与 LG Display 签署联合开发协议以加速下一代 OLED 发光材料商业化。
news.why: 两大韩国面板厂同时入股并推进联合开发，表明 TADF/Hyperfluorescence 材料正加速走向量产导入，将影响 OLED 发光材料供应链格局。

items.title: Researchers develop a record-efficiency white OLED that uses a single MR-TADF emitter molecule
items.abstract: Researchers from China's Jilin University and Ji Hua Laboratory have developed a warm-white OLED that uses a single light-emitting molecule (a single dopant). The new emitter, called Th-DBN, is a multi-resonance TADF (MR-TADF) material that emits blue-green light on its own, and orange-yellow light when two molecules stack together. The device reaches an external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 27.1%, which the researchers say is the highest reported to date for a purely organic single-dopant white OLED - nearly double the previous record. Most white OLEDs mix several emitters (red, green and blue, or sky blue and yellow). Every extra emitter adds steps to the deposition process and raises the cost, and as different materials carry charge at different speeds, the color can drift as the brightness changes. A single molecule that emits white light on its own is a simpler solution, but until now such purely organic single-dopant devices stayed below 15% EQE.

items.title: Kyulux raises $53.7 million in a Series D round backed by LG Display and Samsung, signs a joint development agreement with LGD
items.abstract: Japan-based TADF and Hyperfluorescence OLED emitter developer Kyulux has raised 8.5 billion Yen (about $53.7 million USD) in a Series D funding round, which values the company at around $272 million. Investors include SMBC Capital Partners (part of Japan's SMBC Group), Korean private equity firm H&Q and BNW. Both Korean panel makers joined the round as strategic investors: LG Display invested directly, and Samsung invested through Samsung Venture Investment Corporation. Kyulux CEO Jungkil (Jake) Lee Alongside the investment, Kyulux signed a joint development agreement (JDA) with LG Display, to accelerate the commercialization of its next-generation OLED emitter materials. LG Display has backed Kyulux for a long time - it first invested $2.8 million in the company back in 2016 , and Samsung Display was also among Kyulux's early investors .
